The paper "LogicAsker: Evaluating and Improving the Logical Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models" does not claim that GPT-4 has flawless logical reasoning; in fact, it reports the opposite [2401.00757].

The authors state that their methodology reveals "significant gaps in LLMs' learning of logical rules," with identified reasoning failures ranging from 29% to 90% across different models [2401.00757]. Consequently, LogicAsker was developed as a tool to evaluate and improve these reasoning capabilities, rather than to prove them flawless [2401.00757].
